title: Lens and perspective correction
objective: Deliver offline rectilinear profile distortion and manual two-axis perspective through shared bounded geometry, preserving content coordinates, immutable history and exact export while preventing duplicate embedded DNG correction.
context_summary: Planning only: no feature is implemented by this file. The owner requested scope/approach decisions without an owner-review gate. docs/design/lens-and-perspective.md selects a pinned Lensfun v0.3.4 database subset, explicit profile selection, two-axis perspective and fixed-canvas automatic coverage. Existing affine crop/mask contracts need a nonlinear host primitive and one sampling boundary. Required DNG optics remain in source development, with shared per-operation eligibility refusing a second distortion. Early numerical work must qualify conservative coverage and bilinear minification limits; missing camera/lens photographic evidence stays untested. Existing module/API, history, export, cancellation and resource contracts remain authoritative.
